title: Typography / photographic campaign pair
slide_intent: Keep a short message legible against photography so viewers can grasp a campaign at a glance.
strategic_value: Bold white headlines and red DB marks can connect different travel stories.
demonstration: Two campaign compositions pair photographs with heavy white headlines: SCHNELLER AM ZIEL and BERLIN.
practical_value: Compare a compact left-aligned headline with a large destination name near the lower edge.

content_islands.name: Arrival campaign
content_islands.spec: Place the short headline beside the photographed travelers at left.

content_islands.name: Berlin campaign
content_islands.spec: Place the destination and fare over the lower part of the outdoor photograph at right.

reference_purposes.Expression: Both compositions pair heavy white lettering with photographs.
reference_purposes.Application: The type is shown in two finished travel communications.
